content: सिन्धुः [स्यन्द्-उद् संप्रसारणं दस्य धश्च <ls>Tv.</ls>; <ls>Uṇ. 1. 11</ls>] .²1 The sea, ocean; तावत् त्रिभुवनं सद्यः कल्पान्तैधितसिन्धवः <ls>Bhāg. 3. 11. 30</ls>. .²2 The Indus. .²3 The country around the Indus. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a river in Mālavā; वेणीभूतप्रतनुसलिला तामतीतस्य सिन्धुः <ls>Me. 29</ls> (where <ls>Malli.</ls>ʼs remark सिन्धुर्नाम नदी तु कुत्रापि नास्ति is gratuitous); पारासिन्धुसंभेदमवगाह्य नगरीमेव प्रविशावः <ls>Māl. 4. 9/10</ls> (see <ls>Dr. Bhāndārkarʼs note</ls> {%ad loc.%}). .²5 The water ejected from an elephantʼs trunk. .²6 The juice exuding from the temples of an elephant. .²7 An elephant. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of Varuṇa. .²9 White borax. .²10 A kind of musical mode (राग). -<ab>pl.</ab> The inhabitants of the {%Sindhu%} country. --{%f.%} .²1 A great river or river in general; पिबत्यसौ पाययते च सिन्धूः <ls>R. 13. 9</ls>; <ls>Me. 48</ls>; <ls>Ś. 5. 21</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 6</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">5. 85</ls>. .²2 The river Sindhu.
